messages.content: Decide if today is good for an outdoor team meeting. Check the weather in SF and the AAPL stock price (the CFO wants to discuss it). If weather is clear and above 15°C, create an outdoor event at 2pm. If not, create an indoor event. Either way, notify the engineering team. Do everything yourself.
